# Documentation Home [¶](https://docs.horizon3.ai/\#documentation-home "Link for Documentation Home")

All the info you need to deploy, configure, and maximize the effectiveness of NodeZero, our autonomous penetration testing platform. Whether you’re a security analyst, system administrator, or DevOps engineer, this is where you’ll find step-by-step guides, integration instructions, and troubleshooting resources to help you identify, prioritize, and remediate weaknesses across your environment.

Here's a suggested sequence to put NodeZero to work securing your environment – scroll down for more resources.
